title: Good if you don't use it for kneading dough, will overheat doing that- not powerful enough
text:
Good if you don't use it for kneading dough, will overheat doing that- not powerful enough. This thing isn't powerful enough to do bread dough so don't even think about it. It'll overheat and in time you'll burn it up for sure. It has an overheat warning to keep it from burning up right now but you're overworking the motor with dough, it can't handle what the higher powered more expensive stand mixers can.

SO if you're fine paying $200 for a mixer that's only good for lighter ingredients then I say go for it but honestly you can find stand mixers for about $50 ish that'll do the same stuff as this. Considering neither can be used for bread dough, why would you pay $200 when you can pay $50?

This accepts Kitchenaid attachments for the power hub on the front of it but not for the mixer attachments that go down into the bowl sadly. That would have been a nice addition. Overall I'm not impressed and kind of insulted with this price point and lack of power.

5.3 QT Capacity Mixing Bowl & 3 Accessories - 5.3 Quart stainless steel bowl with handle can mix up to 10 dozen cookies or 5 loaf of bread or 15 pounds of mashed potatoes in one batch. Dishwasher safe. Model KM50 includes 1*stainless steel dough hook, 1* 12-Wire Whip, 1*coated beater, 1*plastic pouring shield. 3 years warranty.
